steps.title: Privilege gateway
steps.what: When an agent calls a Remote Agent through the gateway, the gateway inspects the whole request body (every text part, data part and the metadata, for both single and streaming messages) using the AI Guard settings on the calling agent's key.
steps.why: An agent that receives text from another agent can be hit with prompt injection, impersonation, jailbreak or data-exfiltration requests.
